name: Radiant Logistics, Inc.
summary: Radiant Logistics, Inc., operates as a third-party logistics company, provides technology-enabled global transportation and value-added logistics services in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The company offers domestic and international air and ocean freight forwarding, and freight brokerage services, including truckload, less-than-truckload (LTL), and intermodal. It also provides other value-added logistics services including materials management and distribution, customs house brokerage, global trade management, and related technology services, as well as arranging shipments, and heavyweight and small package air services.
